description: Update sudoers on prod during SLO incident — quorum required

playbook.content:
- name: Add temporary sudo access
  hosts: production
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: /etc/sudoers
        line: 'oncall-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL'

tier_rationale: SLO burn rate 78% — changes during incident require quorum
